sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing or using Link2Builder, you agree to comply with these Terms, our Privacy Policy, and all applicable laws. If you do not agree, you must not use the platform.

sections.heading: 2. Platform Overview
sections.content: Link2Builder is a digital platform that connects buyers with verified builders via video calls to explore real estate projects before physical visits.

sections.heading: 3. User Eligibility
list: You must be 18 years or older
You must provide accurate and complete information
Fake accounts or impersonation are strictly prohibited

sections.heading: 4. Account Responsibility
list: You are responsible for your login credentials
Any activity under your account is your responsibility
Link2Builder is not liable for unauthorized account access

sections.heading: 5. Services Offered
list: Free/paid video consultations with builders
Project information and property listings
Direct communication with builders
sections.note: Important: Link2Builder is a facilitator, not a property seller. We do not guarantee property availability, pricing, or investment returns.

sections.heading: 6. Builder Verification Disclaimer
sections.content: Builders may be “verified” through internal checks. However, users must conduct their own due diligence before any transaction.

sections.heading: 7. Payments & Charges
list: Some services may be free (e.g., video calls)
Any paid services must be paid in advance
Payments once made may be non-refundable unless stated otherwise

sections.heading: 8. Prohibited Activities

Harass or abuse other users/builders

sections.heading: 9. Intellectual Property

sections.heading: 10. Third-Party Interactions
sections.content: Any deal between buyer and builder is independent of Link2Builder. We are not responsible for disputes, fraud, or project issues.

sections.heading: 11. Limitation of Liability
list: Property disputes
Financial loss or investment risks

sections.heading: 12. Termination

sections.heading: 13. Changes to Terms
sections.content: We may update these terms at any time. Continued use means acceptance of updated terms.

sections.heading: 14. Governing Law
